entities.name: UbiE-like methyltransferase
observations: 244-aa sequence; estimated mass 27.22 kDa, pI 8.88, GRAVY −0.104, instability index 32.45.
65.5% identical over 96–98% coverage to reviewed bacterial UbiE proteins Q1LRG9, Q7WF12, and Q7W3N6.
Homology supports a UbiE quinone C-methyltransferase role in menaquinone and ubiquinone biosynthesis; exact substrates are inferred, not experimentally established for this sequence.
Reference annotations use S-adenosyl-L-methionine for quinone methylation; sequence-query report gives no direct experimental cofactor or cellular-localization evidence.

entities.name: Quinone biosynthesis
observations: Reviewed UbiE homologs are annotated in menaquinone and ubiquinone biosynthesis.
